description: Get detailed contents of a specific bin (folder) including all nested items, media paths, offline status, color labels, and metadata. Searches by bin name or node ID.

bin_id.description: Bin name, node ID, or path (e.g., 'Footage', 'Footage/Raw')

limit.description: Maximum direct children to return. Pair with recursive false for the smallest bounded response.

max_depth.description: Maximum nested-bin depth when recursive is true. Defaults to the legacy unlimited recursion.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the bin's direct children. Pair with limit for a bounded page.

recursive.description: Include items from sub-bins recursively (default: true)

name: get_bin_contents

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Bin Contents
